items.name: Library Remote Access
items.description: Use OpenAthens to access library subscriptions away from campus.
steps: Open the MIT Central Library portal and choose Login, then Log in with SSO.
Select the MAHE University Microsoft Azure option.
Sign in with your @manipal.edu or @learner.manipal.edu email.

items.name: MIT Study Abroad Programme
items.description: Find semester eligibility, academic requirements, application documents, and credit transfer instructions.
steps: Check the published eligibility requirements and select a host university.
Submit the application and parent or guardian undertaking for review.
Obtain course approval and a learning agreement before arranging travel. Start at least six months ahead.
